generate-leads.metaDescription: Capture more qualified leads from Google search and marketing campaigns.
generate-leads.title: Generate Leads
generate-leads.subtitle: Turn traffic into a steady pipeline of business opportunities.
generate-leads.body: Mendeles helps you capture leads from the channels that matter — organic search, paid campaigns, and referrals. Build high-converting funnels, track every inquiry, and grow your customer base with confidence.

seo-landing-pages.metaDescription: Rank on Google and convert visitors with SEO-optimized landing pages.
seo-landing-pages.title: SEO Landing Pages
seo-landing-pages.subtitle: Get found on Google and convert the traffic you earn.
seo-landing-pages.body: Create landing pages designed for search intent — fast, mobile-friendly, and structured for rankings. Mendeles connects SEO performance to lead capture so every visit has the potential to become revenue.

marketing-automation.metaDescription: Automate follow-ups and nurture leads into customers.
marketing-automation.title: Marketing Automation
marketing-automation.subtitle: Never lose a lead because follow-up was too slow.
marketing-automation.body: Automate reminders, nurture sequences, and handoffs so your team responds at the right moment. Mendeles keeps acquisition moving while you focus on closing deals.

ai-qualification.metaDescription: Use AI to score and prioritize leads most likely to convert.
ai-qualification.title: AI Qualification
ai-qualification.subtitle: Spend time on leads that are ready to buy.
ai-qualification.body: AI helps score incoming leads based on intent and fit, so sales teams prioritize the highest-value opportunities. Reduce wasted effort and increase close rates.

lead-management.metaDescription: Track, assign, and manage leads in one centralized platform.
lead-management.title: Lead Management
lead-management.subtitle: One place for every opportunity in your pipeline.
lead-management.body: Organize leads by source, status, and owner. Mendeles gives small businesses and agencies the visibility they need to convert more inquiries into paying customers.

analytics.metaDescription: Track business growth, conversions, and customer acquisition performance.
analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.subtitle: Measure what actually grows your business.
analytics.body: See which pages, campaigns, and keywords drive leads and revenue. Mendeles analytics focus on business outcomes — not vanity metrics — so you invest in what works.
